info.syllabusName: Principles of Compositing _Thiết kế hình ảnh và âm thanh trong làm phim
info.description: - This course will teach students how to make motion graphics and how to create visual effects using Adobe After Effects software. At the end of the course, students will know how to apply the knowledge of timing, rhythm, composition to create a complete animation product
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

- Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Photoshop, Microsoft Word for written assignments, and POWERPOINT for presentations

- Have color papers, Color Pencils, scissors...

clos.loDetails: Students are able to combine principles of graphic design and motion, and able to create animated graphics which highlight harmony and unity between images and sounds
Understanding the fundamentals of digital animation
Basic design principals as it applies to Motion Graphics
Use After Effects efficiently and effectively
Creatively integrate text, image, video and sound using motion graphics techniques
Create professional animation sequences and composites using a variety of features
Having a professional working style. Practice and develop ethics, professionalism.

assessments.note: An individual work to demonstrate the student's ability to understand and to apply motion graphic in practice. The topic will be announced by the lecturer in the Lecture

assessments.gradingGuide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.
